source_note: Verified Physics Form One scheme of work for Term II (TIE curriculum). 14 weeks: Mechanical Properties of Matter (Weeks 1-3), Pressure (Weeks 4-6), Linear Motion (Weeks 7-9), Work, Energy, and Power (Weeks 11-13). Week 10 is mid-term assessment and break; Week 14 is annual examinations/closing of the academic year. 4 periods per week (two 80-min double periods).
